plan.name: Reuse captured repository facts
plan.summary: Add repository.ErrFileMissing for a safe regular-file path absent from a captured tree, keep ErrMissing exclusive to an absent repository contract, and make ReadRepositoryDraft use errors.Is while continuing to reject existing acceptance files, unsafe paths and unreadable objects. Expose Snapshot.DirectoryOwner(path) (Part, bool, error), returning an independent deepest enclosing part or false for a safe path without one, and use its directory rule in PartsFor and native binding while preserving shared and dependency owners, global document selection, component boundaries and rejection of every unsafe or unowned touched path. Reuse successful committed blob reads within each immutable snapshot with independent returned bytes, race-safe concurrent access and each caller's cancellation honored on hits and reads, without caching failures or using moving refs or candidate bytes as authority. Use the existing dependencyHash helper for the unchanged version-1 execution JSON and sha256 encoding, preserving exact input bytes, sorted declarations, argv order, rule/document and other-part dependency exclusions, all native and legacy hashes and locks, and commit provenance outside the ratified hash; changed policy or relevant input bytes in a new snapshot must still invalidate authority. Update docs/factory.md and the affected SPEC.md repository and native-identity descriptions with D-0301 and D-0314 citations and D-0105/D-0122 as applicable, leave recording the new snapshot API/cache decision to the merger, keep external plumbing disabled, and validate the affected Go suites plus the cache tests under the race detector with deterministic Git-read evidence and no Docker or network.

tests.name: TestSnapshotMissingFileClassification661
tests.says: Only a safe absent file in a captured tree matches ErrFileMissing; unsafe paths, cancellation and unreadable objects do not, and ErrMissing still means only an absent contract.

tests.name: TestSnapshotDirectoryOwner661
tests.says: The independent directory owner respects nested parts, root fallback and path boundaries for existing, new and deleted paths, while PartsFor preserves additional owners and rejects unsafe or unowned paths.

tests.name: TestSnapshotReusesBlobs661
tests.says: Repeated and concurrent reads reuse successful captured blob bytes without Git rereads or shared mutable results, honor canceled callers, retry failures and keep new snapshots independent.

tests.name: TestNativeDirectoryOwnerBinding661
tests.says: Native binding agrees with the snapshot's directory owner and cannot use ancestor, shared or dependency check owners to execute elsewhere, including paths with no enclosing part.

tests.name: TestNativeDigestReusesCapturedBytes661
tests.says: Repeated validation performs no new Git reads of captured inputs, keeps the exact pre-change digest and plan hash for equivalent authority, preserves provenance and exclusions, and refuses changed policy or relevant input bytes.

usage.summary: Wrote [plan.json](plan.json) and five acceptance tests covering typed absence, ownership, blob reuse, cancellation, and unchanged hashes. The check passed on the first attempt; all tests fail against the unchanged base, and `repo/` remains untouched.
